svg.title: Transit Theogony
svg.text: to Athena · Apollo · Artemis · Hermes + 5 more
to Aether · Hemera · Charon · Moros · Nemesis · Hypnos
Station: a figure on one line
Interchange: a line starts or joins
Consecutive stops on a line are parent and child. Where two parents’ lines arrive side by side,
the station is their child: Ares and Hebe are children of Zeus and Hera. The zones are the
generations. An interchange is where a new line begins, or where lines come together. Only
the lineages above are drawn; the full genealogy has 79 figures.
